svg.text: Privacy-First Student Resilience Platform | Production Monorepo

g.text: Public-facing pages, entry points, and primary user interactions. Next.js App Router with Server & Client components.
Complete route coverage (governance, trust, platform/system endpoints)
Search indexing, social cards, AI/crawler discoverability
Runtime reliability, fallback UX, API surface
Business logic, algorithms, and intelligent systems. React components + TypeScript utilities.
Data persistence, caching, and state management. Browser APIs + future backend integration.
Node.js HTTP services, endpoints, and business logic. Ready for scaling to microservices.
Deployment, CDN, external APIs, and third-party integrations. Production-ready infrastructure.
✓ Privacy-First: Client-side processing where possible, minimal data collection, GDPR-aware
✓ Scalable Monorepo: Workspaces for apps & packages, independent CI/CD, shared types
✓ Modular AI: RAG for resilience guidance, RCSM for peer matching, optional LLM services
✓ Safety-Gated: Consent flows, content review, fairness audits, crisis escalation paths
✓ Cloud-Native: Docker-ready backend, Vercel edge functions, async jobs & workers ready
